items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1963-03-28
items.q: Isidore's dad, I think. Over there in Thompson? Lake Branche? Yeah, over around Covington he played in Mandeville.

ctx.x: The other, they called him E Flatt. Well, now, the Fritz brothers... Good kind of guy, we guessed him over there. Yeah. Isidore's dad, I think. Over there in Thompson? Lake Branche? Yeah, over around Covington he played in Mandeville.
Yeah. Good kind of guy, and his brother played guitar.
